title: DevX initiative habit & health scorecard — SDKs/docs/quickstarts
creator: Lena Chen
description: Create a lightweight, repeatable scorecard and accompanying ritual to track the health and adoption velocity of developer experience initiatives (SDKs, docs, quickstarts). The goal is to provide PMs, Eng, and Design a single weekly signal that combines activation, quality regressions, and effort friction so teams can make prioritization decisions and alert early on regressions. This ticket scopes the MVP: metric definitions, dashboard prototype, weekly meeting template, and automation to surface anomalies.
acceptance_criteria: A1: Scorecard calculates a weekly health score from defined signals (activation, retention, docs traffic, quickstart success rate, SDK release adoption).
A2: Dashboard prototype (Looker/Metabase) shows last 8 weeks of each signal plus composite score and highlights top 3 negative deltas automatically.
A3: Weekly ritual template published (meeting agenda, owners, follow-ups) and embedded in Confluence with links to dashboard.
A4: Two automation rules: email/Slack alert when composite score drops >= 15% week-over-week or when quickstart failure rate > 5%.
A5: Hand-off notes and decision playbook for how to triage score regressions are documented and shared with DevX guild.

comments: 2026-03-01 — Lena: Kickoff completed. Aligned on outcome: reduce time-to-detect regressions for SDK/quickstarts from weeks to <48h. Action: Rohan to run signal workshop 2026-03-03.

2026-03-03 — Rohan: Workshop notes uploaded to Drive: https://drive.redwood/company/devx/scorecard/workshop-notes. Consensus on 6 signals: new activation rate, 7-day retention, quickstart success rate, SDK install errors, docs adjusted bounce rate, GitHub example PRs merged.
2026-03-05 — ENG analytics: Initial event queries created (refs in repo: github.com/redwood/devx-analytics/pulls/142). Several SDK install error events need normalization across languages.
2026-03-08 — Design (Maya): Proposed dashboard mocks in Figma: https://figma.com/file/DEVX-scorecard. Recommend emphasising delta sparklines and an anomaly band.
2026-03-10 — Priya: Pilot owners confirmed (JavaScript SDK, Python SDK). Pilot start date 2026-03-15. Added pilot checklist to Confluence.

2026-03-12 — Rohan: Implemented composite scoring prototype. Current weighting (provisional): activation 25%, retention 20%, quickstart success 25%, SDK errors 20%, docs bounce 10%. Open item: validate weights against historical regressions.
decisions: Use composite weekly score to prioritize pull-through fixes (decision 2026-03-03).
Start with weekly cadence and human review; automated runbooks for recurring regressions are out of scope for MVP (decision 2026-03-05).
Adopt provisional weights and re-evaluate after 4-week pilot (decision 2026-03-12).
risks: Signal reliability: SDK error telemetry is inconsistent across languages — may cause noisy alerts.
Overfitting weights to historical incidents — composite score may underrepresent novel issues.
Dashboard fatigue: too many alerts if thresholds are not tuned; requires careful initial tuning and an opt-out for low-impact repos.
progress: Analytics queries 70% complete; dashboard mock approved; pilot owners recruited. Next milestone: run pilot 2026-03-15 and collect 2 weeks of data to validate weights.
